name: @patchbay-nebius/mcp

tools.name: build_connector
tools.description: Describe an integration in one sentence ("When X happens in A, do Y in B"). patchbay plans it, researches both APIs, generates a connector with tests and a README, then verifies it in a sandbox with up to N repair attempts. Default language is TypeScript (vitest); set lang: "py" for Python 3.12 (pytest). Falls back to the recorded TypeScript replay run when live API keys are missing.

lang.description: Target language. "ts" (default) emits TypeScript+vitest; "py" emits Python 3.12+pytest. Live keys required for "py".

tools.name: research_api
tools.description: Plan + Tavily-backed API research only. Returns the connector plan, the ranked documentation sources, and a normalized API spec (endpoints, auth, example payloads). No code is generated and no sandbox is used, so this is cheap and fast.

tools.name: scan_repo
tools.description: Walk a repository (local directory or shallow-cloned GitHub URL) and report the integration opportunities patchbay could build: webhook handlers with TODO/empty bodies, .env.example entries pointing at vendor APIs with no implementation, TODO/FIXME comments mentioning vendors, and vendor SDKs imported but barely used. Understands TypeScript/JavaScript (Express/Next/Fastify routes) AND Python (FastAPI/Flask routes, pass bodies, raise NotImplementedError). Returns a ranked list, each item with a ready-to-run prompt the agent can hand straight to build_connector. Instant, free (no LLM / sandbox), auditable regex-only output.

path.description: Absolute path to a repo directory on disk, or a GitHub URL (https://github.com/<owner>/<repo> — shallow-cloned to a tempdir and scanned).

topN.description: How many top-ranked opportunities to return. Default 15.

tools.name: verify_code
tools.description: Type-check and test an existing connector (files you provide as {path, content}) in an isolated Nebius sandbox, with up to N repair attempts from the strong model. For TypeScript (default) the gate is tsc + vitest; for Python (lang: "py") it is compileall + pytest. Requires live keys (NEBIUS_API_KEY, NEBIUS_AI_PROJECT); returns the final test report and the (possibly repaired) files.

path.description: Relative path inside the connector (e.g. src/connector.ts)

files.description: Connector files. For TS, include src/connector.ts + a *.test.ts; for Python, include connector.py + test_connector.py.

lang.description: Target language the files are in. "ts" (default) or "py". If omitted, auto-detected from file extensions.

tools.name: audit_mcp_server
tools.description: Scan a remote MCP server URL (or a local MCP connector directory) for OAuth 2.1, RFC 8707 audience validation, RFC 8252 loopback redirects, OAuth metadata, scope posture, secret surface, tool manifest drift, and tool-description prompt injection patterns. Returns a letter grade, numeric score and the full findings list. Runs zero-auth probing by default (metadata-level checks only). Pass "authToken" to probe behind authentication. Pass "probeAudienceToken" to enable AUDIENCE-001 (cross-audience token check, RFC 8707). Pass "probeMissingAudToken" to enable AUDIENCE-002 (missing-aud-claim check, catches the if (aud && aud !== me) reject early-exit bug). Pass "probeDcrLoopback: true" to enable AUTH-006 (writes a throw-away client registration to the authorization server). Pass "probeHeadlessOauth: true" to enable the OAuth 2.1 conformance battery (PKCE-001 missing PKCE, PKCE-002 plain PKCE, IMPLICIT-001 implicit grant, REDIRECT-002 unregistered redirect_uri). The scanner never calls any of the server's tools.

target.description: MCP server URL (https://...) or absolute path to a local connector directory.

authToken.description: Bearer token to send on every probe request. Use for servers that require authentication beyond initialize.

probeAudienceToken.description: Bearer token minted for a DIFFERENT resource on the same authorization server. Enables AUDIENCE-001 (RFC 8707 cross-audience check).

probeMissingAudToken.description: Bearer token whose JWT payload has NO aud claim at all. Enables AUDIENCE-002 (catches `if (aud && aud !== me) reject` early-exit bug per RFC 9068 Section 4).

probeDcrLoopback.description: Opt into AUTH-006 active Dynamic Client Registration loopback probe (RFC 8252 Section 7.3). Writes a throw-away client to the authorization server; off by default.

probeHeadlessOauth.description: Opt into the OAuth 2.1 conformance battery (PKCE-001, PKCE-002, IMPLICIT-001, REDIRECT-002). Registers a throw-away client via DCR, then sends four crafted /authorize requests. Off by default.
